construction_phase_sets.spec: docs/FARM_TYPES_SPEC.md section 6.3 (Construction in 3D); the first row of every table is a phase, engine_phases are the keys of LandConstructionPhases.cs and OffshoreProfiles.cs that draw it

Blast pad.note: Blast mats cover the blast area while the pad is blasted (the first 60 % of site_works), the excavator works beside them: ConstructionKitVisual draws both in the middle of the blasted ground, where the camera frames the campus, and takes them away when the blast ends. The heath to granite splat is terrain (F2-19); the dust puff on each blast day is a particle effect no spec row owns yet. Neither is a mesh.

Foundations.note: The concrete rings on the pad are the tanks' own plinths: at build progress 0.02 to 0.07 the shell discards everything above 0.3 to 0.9 m and the 0.35 m concrete plinth stays (LandCampusBuilder RING_PROGRESS).

Tank rings rise.note: Walls rise through INSTANCE_CUSTOM.r; the scaffold ring (13 m, as tall as the shell) is instanced on each rising grow-out tank (a Ø29.5 m ring does not fit a pre-grow tank) and revealed by the same build progress (ConstructionKitVisual). It is struck when tank_rings ends: its top lift (boards at 12 m, rail at 13 m, R 14.48 to 14.77) stands in the height band of the tank's walkway (grating from 12.57 m, R up to 15.3), which the walls' top progress (WALLS_TOP_PROGRESS 0.96 = 12.48 m) has not yet revealed.

Treatment hall.note: Hall bays and the harvest hall appear; the tower crane stands at the inland end of each lot whose hall rises, its jib over a first tank (ConstructionKitVisual; none on a post-smolt site, where it would dwarf a 16 m tank, nor where the pad leaves no room behind the lot).

Intake and outfall.note: Basin wall, pump house and pipe lines in the lens; the quay and the pipe bridge.

Commissioning.note: Lid work-lights and the feeders come on as tanks are handed over (the biofilter maturation gauge is UI).

First smolt.note: After construction (first stocking): the wellboat at the quay, the orange bridge carrying fish.

Yard contract.note: A picture-in-picture card of the asset; four survey buoys mark the plot.

Hull rises.note: Part groups of the unit appear phase by phase (no extra meshes: spec 5.3).

Voyage.note: The unit approaches on the horizon.

Tow to the plot.note: Three anchor tugs: godot/assets/models/offshore_service/anchor_tug.tscn (F2-27), the offshore_service mesh with a red hull swatch (the brief's workboat red #C8102E), no new geometry (spec 5.2 anchor_tug).

Mooring.note: Tugs at the anchor points; the mooring lines (8 for OF1 at 1,100 m, 11 for Havfarm at 650 m) are mooring_line_kit, delivered by F2-29.

First stocking.note: After construction (first stocking): the wellboat alongside.
